dict.string: Snappet connects over Bluetooth to your heart-rate band (chest straps, Polar, Garmin, and similar) for live heart rate during a workout, and to a Kilter Board to light up climbs. Everything stays on your device.

Snappet uses the camera to record a video clip while you log a workout set, to scan a receipt (to pull out the line items and split them), and to scan a Kilter climb's QR code a friend shared. Everything is processed on your device; nothing is uploaded.
Snappet records sound with the video clips you film during a workout. The recording is saved only to your own photo library — nothing leaves your device.
Snappet matches your Kilter board to where you are, fully on your device — your location never leaves your phone.
Snappet reads your workout heart rate to find your most intense moments and build a highlight reel.
Snappet does not write health data.
Snappet saves your finished highlight reel back to your library.
Snappet finds the photos and videos you shot during your workout to build your reel, and — only when you ask — saves your edits over the original or removes a clip from your library.
